records.question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2017?

records.question: Which products are most popular?
records.raw:
SELECT oi.product_id,
       COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS units_sold,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS num_orders
FROM order_items oi

records.question: Do orders delivered late receive lower review scores?

JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL;

records.question: Compare revenue for January to August 2017 against the same period in 2018.
records.raw:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-09-01' THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2017,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01' THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2018
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
  AND (
    (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-09-01')
    OR
    (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01')
  );
records.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-09-01' THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2017,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01' THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2018
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
  AND (
    (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-09-01')
    OR

records.question: What was the month-on-month revenue growth rate through 2017?
records.raw:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2016-12-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    month,
    (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS growth_rate
FROM monthly_revenue
WHERE month >= '2017-01-01' AND month < '2018-01-01'
ORDER BY month;
